correctness.rationale: Binary cylinder 00 or 11 equals the two-digit event B_j=B_{j+1}=E_j under Lebesgue fair-bit coding. State-count transitions yield exact 2x2 and 3x3 matrices for the mean and shared-environment second moment. Independent enumeration checks all 49 rational parameter/horizon pairs. The 2x2 characteristic polynomial gives the first root and its Jordan boundary; the cubic second-root polynomial and identity P_p(q_+^2)=4p(p-1)q_+(q_+-1)(4q_+^2-3)<0 establish strict Perron separation for all 0<p<1. Primitivity yields positive asymptotic constants; bit complement gives zero variance at endpoints. Finite checks are not infinite proofs.

They do not state the two independent small transfer matrices for a stationary Markov selector of two disjoint binary cylinders, nor a proved strict Perron gap for the relative environmental second moment for every 0<p<1. value.rationale: Conditional survivor mass of a shared environmental hole is a direct experimental observable in random open systems. The theorem gives exact environmental mean, exact second moment, and the complete retention-parameter classification of relative fluctuations, exhibiting strict exponential amplification at all stochastic interior parameters despite deterministic zero variance at both endpoints. The nontrivial polynomial Perron-gap identity differentiates it from routine one-step escape bookkeeping; the model is a natural dyadic test family, not an arbitrary finite slice.
